findings.finding: Nonreversibility, reflection positivity and cycle interactions overstated.
findings.resolution: Scope the explicit nonreversible example, positive fugacity and spectral inequalities; unit-removal birth law; incorporate refreshed PR8530 conditional-population correction and distinguish event-rate sampling; separate simple cycles from overlapping 2-core contractions.

findings.finding: Cross pinning energy treated as complete interaction; sustained positive finite-capacity forcing; massless torus inverse and universal capacity scaling unsupported.
findings.resolution: Full quadratic pinning cost and normalization distinction; formal response with actual source saturation; mixed-content formation counterexample; positive screened domain and zero-charge massless periodic boundary case; no arbitrary body-size or exact decay-length claim.

findings.finding: Discrete Euler sampling treated as exact continuous transit; sequential killing has wrong static mass; momentum and force scopes omit body impulse and face balance.
findings.resolution: Separate discrete model and continuous generator, low-mode lower bound with alternating-mode exception; corrected mass denominator; body-inclusive reflection balance; conditional local-equilibrium sound; degenerate sphere redraw classes.

findings.finding: Six-axis exchange cross flux omitted, physical force missing sqrt3 normalization, isotropic wind and unbiased capture asserted without assumptions.
findings.resolution: Retain -g_i g_j, distinguish scaled stress, require spherical closure and first-harmonic balanced capture geometry. Finite bond Hodge identities only, rest tensor symmetry and units scoped; transparent-body force retained as conditional coefficient algebra.

findings.finding: Collisions said to restore isotropy; rigid fixed footprint conflated with N=M growth; zero net flux said to remove all inverse-square fields.
findings.resolution: Propagate cubic-viscosity correction, fixed-ray vector remainder and Hessian operator bound, separate growing-active-site idealization, explicit uniform-emission routing, monopole-only no-go and constant-parameter growth bound.

findings.finding: Weighted redraw could be read as repairing local streaming; Fourier sink sign inconsistent; capture per-face and arbitrary damping claims too broad.
findings.resolution: Weighted redraw cannot cancel streaming defect, pin counts; consistent sink sign, elliptic continuum scope and projected generic damping; homogeneous-reservoir aggregate capture, alpha=c price and higher-order lattice terms.

findings.finding: Historical simulation reports and process certificates cannot certify current canonical science.
findings.resolution: Fresh14 caches,14 consequential mutations,14 independent controls; explicit224 ancillary dispositions and preserved source branches; no audit verdict or status outputs.
